paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit, chapter 10, end of halakhah 3; Hyman reports Rabbi Chiyya bar Ada as the Venice printing’s reading.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Guggenheimer digital text of Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 10:3 names Rabbi Chiyya bar Ada. Hyman’s full Rav Chuna heading and his report of the Venice reading are retained separately; this digital text is not proof of Venice printing pixels.
